module: Creates and records a mission attempt for a rally loop through the mission progress system (gameplay_missions_progress). A normal-finish attempt receives the total time, the penalty, the time of each stage (timeSS1, timeSS2...), the vehicle data and the stars earned; a DNF attempt (abandon or restart) receives only the DNF type and the vehicle. Called by the loop manager (rallyLoopManager) via the mgr object.
notes: Both public functions return (attempt, totalChange) in this order, whereas the code comment only mentions totalChange (and, for the normal finish, the order stated in the comment is reversed).
If mgr:getRallyLoopMissionId() returns nil, an error log is emitted and the function returns nil without recording anything.
addVehicleData calls dump(vData): the vehicle table is printed to the console on every attempt.

createRallyLoopAttemptForFinish.desc: Creates a normal-finish attempt: time and penalties from mgr, time of each stage, player vehicle, star rating (RallyLoopStars.gradeAttempt), aggregation into the mission progress, then save.

mgr.desc: Loop manager (rallyLoopManager): must provide getRallyLoopMissionId, getTotalPenalty, getTotalTime, getEventLog and optionally getRallyLoopMission.

returns.desc: The attempt object created (nil if the mission id is not found).

createRallyLoopAttemptForDnf.desc: Creates an abandoned (DNF) attempt: sets attempt.dnf = true, records the dnfType and the current mission id, adds the vehicle, aggregates and saves. No stars or times are recorded.

mgr.desc: Loop manager (rallyLoopManager): must provide getRallyLoopMissionId and getCurrentMissionId.

returns.desc: The attempt object created (nil if the mission id is not found).
